articles.summary: UDR, Inc. (the “Company”) (NYSE: UDR ), a leading multifamily real estate investment trust, announced today that Thomas W. Toomey, Chairman, President, and Chief Executive Officer, and the UDR Executive Team will host a roundtable discussion at the 2026 Citi Global Property CEO Conference on Tuesday, March 3, 2026, at 11:40 a.m. Eastern Time. articles.title: UDR to Participate in 2026 Citi Global Property CEO Conference
